title: Rama pacifies Lakshmana, who is angry with Bharata
introduction: Rama pacifies Lakshmana, saying that Bharata, due to his affection towards his brothers and due to the distress that troubles his mind after hearing of the news of their exile, he came to the forest and not with any other motive. Ashamed of himself to hear the opinion of Rama about Bharata, and descending the tree, Lakshmana hides his abashment by changing the topic. Commanded by Bharata that no disturbance should be caused to the hermitage occupied by Rama, the army encamps around the edge of the mountain, chitrakuta.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायने आदिकावे अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तनवतितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 97th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
सुसम्रब्धम् तु सौमित्रिम् लक्ष्मणम् क्रोध मूर्चितम् |
रामः तु परिसान्त्व्य अथ वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
susamrabdham tu saumitrim lakṣmaṇam krodha mūrcitam |
rāmaḥ tu parisāntvya atha vacanam ca idam abravīt
verses.translation: Rama on the other hand, pacifying Lakshmana (son of Sumitra), who was very much agitated and infatuated with anger, spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
किम् अत्र धनुषा कार्यम् असिना वा सचर्मणा |
महा इष्वासे महा प्राज्ने भरते स्वयम् आगते
verses.iast:
kim atra dhanuṣā kāryam asinā vā sacarmaṇā |
mahā iṣvāse mahā prājne bharate svayam āgate
verses.translation: "While Bharata, wieldin a bow and highly wise-man himself is coming here, what is the use of a bow or sword with a shield?"

verses.devanagari:
पितुस्सत्यं प्रतिश्रुत्य हत्वा भरतमागतम् |
किम् करिष्यामि राज्येन सापवादेन लक्ष्मण
verses.iast:
pitussatyaṃ pratiśrutya hatvā bharatamāgatam |
kim kariṣyāmi rājyena sāpavādena lakṣmaṇa
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! Having promised to make our father's wish a reality. What shall I do with the kingdom by acquiring an ill-fame in killing Bharata who came here to see me?"

verses.devanagari:
यद्द्रव्यं बान्दवानां वा मित्राणां वाक्षये भवत् |
नाहं तप्त्प्रतिगृह्णीयां भक्षान्विषकृतानिव
verses.iast:
yaddravyaṃ bāndavānāṃ vā mitrāṇāṃ vākṣaye bhavat |
nāhaṃ taptpratigṛhṇīyāṃ bhakṣānviṣakṛtāniva
verses.translation: "I should not enjoy the spoils obtained by slaying a relative or friend, like the partaking of a poisoned food."

verses.devanagari:
धर्ममर्थं च कामं च पृथिवीं चापि लक्षण |
इच्छामि भवतामर्थे एतत् प्रतिशृणोमि ते
verses.iast:
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāpi lakṣaṇa |
icchāmi bhavatāmarthe etat pratiśṛṇomi te
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! It is for your sake I desire virtue, legitimately acquired wealth and pleasure or even the earth itself. I promise this to you."

glosses.meaning: arthe = It is for your sake

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातृइणां संग्रहार्थं च सुखार्थं चापि लक्ष्मण |
राज्यमप्यहमिच्छामि सत्येनायुधमालभे
verses.iast:
bhrātṛiṇāṃ saṅgrahārthaṃ ca sukhārthaṃ cāpi lakṣmaṇa |
rājyamapyahamicchāmi satyenāyudhamālabhe
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! I desire the throne only for the protection and happiness of my brothers. I touch my weapon and swear this fact."

verses.devanagari:
नेयं मम मही सौम्य दुर्लभा सागराम्बरा |
न हीच्छेयमधर्मेण शक्रत्वमपि लक्ष्मण
verses.iast:
neyaṃ mama mahī saumya durlabhā sāgarāmbarā |
na hīccheyamadharmeṇa śakratvamapi lakṣmaṇa
verses.translation: "This earth, bounded by the sea is not hard to obtain for me, O the excellent man! I do not indeed wish even the position of Indra by unrighteousness."

verses.devanagari:
यद्विना भरतं त्वां च शत्रुघ्नं चापि मानद |
भवेन्मम सुखं किंचिद्भस्म तत्कुरुतां शिखी
verses.iast:
yadvinā bharataṃ tvāṃ ca śatrughnaṃ cāpi mānada |
bhavenmama sukhaṃ kiñcidbhasma tatkurutāṃ śikhī
verses.translation: "If there be happiness that I could enjoy without Bharata or you or without Shatrughna, may it be without Shatrughna, may it be burnt to ashes by fire, O the honour-giver!"

verses.devanagari:
मन्येऽहमागतोऽयेध्यां भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः |
मम प्राणात्र्पियतरः कुलधर्ममनुस्मरन्
श्रुत्वा प्रव्राजितं मां हि जटावल्कलधारिणम् |
जानक्यासहितं वीर त्वया च पुरुषर्षभ
स्नेहेनाक्रान्तहृदयः शिकेनाकुलितेन्द्रियः |
द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो ह्येष भरतो नान्यथऽऽगतः
verses.iast:
manye'hamāgato'yedhyāṃ bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ |
mama prāṇātrpiyataraḥ kuladharmamanusmaran
śrutvā pravrājitaṃ māṃ hi jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇam |
jānakyāsahitaṃ vīra tvayā ca puruṣarṣabha
snehenākrāntahṛdayaḥ śikenākulitendriyaḥ |
draṣṭumabhyāgato hyeṣa bharato nānyatha''gataḥ
verses.translation: "I think Bharata was back to Ayodhya, with full of affection for his brothers. He is dearer to me than my life- he who is mindful of the duties of his race. Hearing of my exile and that I was wearing matted locks and the antelope skin, accompanied by Seetha and you, O most valiant of warriors, in his devotion towards me and due to the distress that troubles his mind, Bharata has come to see me. He has not come with any other motive."

glosses.meaning: full of affection for his brothers
of the duties of his race
and that I was weraing matted locks and the antelope skin

verses.devanagari:
अम्बाअं च कैकयीं रुष्य परुषं चाप्रियं वदन् |
प्रसाद्य पितरं स्रीमान् राज्यं मे दातुमागतः
verses.iast:
ambāaṃ ca kaikayīṃ ruṣya paruṣaṃ cāpriyaṃ vadan |
prasādya pitaraṃ srīmān rājyaṃ me dātumāgataḥ
verses.translation: "Getting angry with Kaikeyi his mother and speaking unkind and harsh words to her, the glorious Bharata after getting permission from our further, came here to bestow kingdom to me."

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्त कालम् यद् एषो अस्मान् भरतो द्रष्टुम् इग्च्छति |
अस्मासु मनसा अप्य् एष न अहितम् किंचिद् आचरेत्
verses.iast:
prāpta kālam yad eṣo asmān bharato draṣṭum igcchati |
asmāsu manasā apy eṣa na ahitam kiṃcid ācaret
verses.translation: "This is the proper time for Bharata to come here and see us. He does not behave or even think unkindly towards us."

verses.devanagari:
विप्रियम् कृत पूर्वम् ते भरतेन कदा न किम् |
ईदृशम् वा भयम् ते अद्य भरतम् यो अत्र शन्कसे
verses.iast:
vipriyam kṛta pūrvam te bharatena kadā na kim |
īdṛśam vā bhayam te adya bharatam yo atra śankase
verses.translation: "Has Bharata at any time done any harm to you previously? What so the reason for you to be so apprehensive of Bharata now?"

verses.devanagari:
न हि ते निष्ठुरम् वाच्यो भरतो न अप्रियम् वचः |
अहम् ह्य् अप्रियम् उक्तः स्याम् भरतस्य अप्रिये कृते
verses.iast:
na hi te niṣṭhuram vācyo bharato na apriyam vacaḥ |
aham hy apriyam uktaḥ syām bharatasya apriye kṛte
verses.translation: "Indeed, Bharata must not hear harsh or disagreeable word from your lips. If an affront is offered to him, it is offered to me!"

glosses.meaning: is not to be spoken of

verses.devanagari:
कथम् नु पुत्राः पितरम् हन्युः कस्यांचिद् आपदि |
भ्राता वा भ्रातरम् हन्यात् सौमित्रे प्राणम् आत्मनः
verses.iast:
katham nu putrāḥ pitaram hanyuḥ kasyāṃcid āpadi |
bhrātā vā bhrātaram hanyāt saumitre prāṇam ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! How should a son strike his father, even in a distress or a brother strike a brother who is as dear to him as his life?"

glosses.meaning: who is as dear to him as his life?

verses.devanagari:
यदि राज्यस्य हेतोः त्वम् इमाम् वाचम् प्रभाषसे |
वक्ष्यामि भरतम् दृष्ट्वा राज्यम् अस्मै प्रदीयताम्
verses.iast:
yadi rājyasya hetoḥ tvam imām vācam prabhāṣase |
vakṣyāmi bharatam dṛṣṭvā rājyam asmai pradīyatām
verses.translation: "If you are uttering these words for the sake of the kingdom, I shall tell Bharata to give the kingdom to you, when I see him."

glosses.meaning: for the sake of the kingdom

verses.devanagari:
उच्यमानो हि भरतो मया लक्ष्मण तत्त्वतः |
राज्यम् अस्मै प्रयग्च्छ इति बाढम् इत्य् एव वक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
ucyamāno hi bharato mayā lakṣmaṇa tattvataḥ |
rājyam asmai prayagccha iti bāḍham ity eva vakṣyati
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! When Bharata receives this command from me, "Cede the empire to him", he will answer, So, be it."

verses.devanagari:
तथा उक्तो धर्म शीलेन भ्रात्रा तस्य हिते रतः |
लक्ष्मणः प्रविवेश इव स्वानि गात्राणि लज्जया
verses.iast:
tathā ukto dharma śīlena bhrātrā tasya hite rataḥ |
lakṣmaṇaḥ praviveśa iva svāni gātrāṇi lajjayā
verses.translation: At these words spoken by his honourable brother, to whom he was devoted, abashed, shrank into himself.

verses.devanagari:
तद्वाक्यं लक्ष्मणः श्रुत्वा व्रीशितः प्रत्युवाच ह |
त्व मन्ये द्रष्टुमायातः पिता दशरथः स्वयम्
verses.iast:
tadvākyaṃ lakṣmaṇaḥ śrutvā vrīśitaḥ pratyuvāca ha |
tva manye draṣṭumāyātaḥ pitā daśarathaḥ svayam
verses.translation: Listening to these words ashamed, answered: "I think that our father Dasaratha came here to see you himself."

verses.devanagari:
व्रीडितम् लक्ष्मणम् दृष्ट्वा राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह |
एष मन्ये महा बाहुर् इह अस्मान् द्रष्टुम् आगतः
verses.iast:
vrīḍitam lakṣmaṇam dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ pratyuvāca ha |
eṣa manye mahā bāhur iha asmān draṣṭum āgataḥ
verses.translation: Observing the emberassed , Rama said, "I think the mighty armed Dasaratha came here to see us."

verses.devanagari:
अथवा नौ ध्रुवं मन्ये मन्यमानः सुखोचितौ |
वन वासम् अनुध्याय गृहाय प्रतिनेष्यति
verses.iast:
athavā nau dhruvaṃ manye manyamānaḥ sukhocitau |
vana vāsam anudhyāya gṛhāya pratineṣyati
verses.translation: "Or rather, to my mind, as he knows that we have been accustomed to comfort, reflecting that we are dwelling in the forest, he wishes to take us home."

glosses.meaning: that we are dwelling in the forest

verses.devanagari:
इमाम् वा अप्य् एश वैदेहीम् अत्यन्त सुख सेविनीम् |
एतौ तौ सम्प्रकाशेते गोत्रवन्तौ मनो रमौ
verses.iast:
imām vā apy eśa vaidehīm atyanta sukha sevinīm |
etau tau samprakāśete gotravantau mano ramau
verses.translation: "The glorious Dasaratha, my father possibly will take back Seetha from the forest, she who has ever lived in the heart of prosperity."

glosses.meaning: she who has ever lived in the heart of prosperity.

verses.devanagari:
एतौ तौ संप्रकाशेते गोत्रवन्तौ मनोरमौ |
वायु वेग समौ वीर जवनौ तुरग उत्तमौ
verses.iast:
etau tau samprakāśete gotravantau manoramau |
vāyu vega samau vīra javanau turaga uttamau
verses.translation: "O, warrior! See those two excellent horses of noble breed, shining attractively and vying with the wind in swiftness."

verses.devanagari:
स एष सुमहा कायः कम्पते वाहिनी मुखे |
नागः शत्रुम्जयो नाम वृद्धः तातस्य धीमतः
verses.iast:
sa eṣa sumahā kāyaḥ kampate vāhinī mukhe |
nāgaḥ śatrumjayo nāma vṛddhaḥ tātasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: "Here is that colossal elephant who is moving at the head of the army called Shatrunjaya, the aged companion of our sagacious father."

glosses.meaning: at the head of the army

verses.devanagari:
न तु पश्यामि तच्छत्रं पाण्डरं लोकसत्कृअम् |
पितुर्दिव्यं महाबाहो संशयो भवतीह मे
verses.iast:
na tu paśyāmi tacchatraṃ pāṇḍaraṃ lokasatkṛam |
piturdivyaṃ mahābāho saṃśayo bhavatīha me
verses.translation: "O, the mighty armed! But I do not see that white heavenly canopy of our father, well known insignia in the world. An apprehension on this point is created in my mind."

verses.devanagari:
वृक्षाग्रादवरोह त्वं कुरु लक्ष्म्मण मद्वचः |
इतीव रामो धर्मात्मा सौमित्रिं तमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
vṛkṣāgrādavaroha tvaṃ kuru lakṣmmaṇa madvacaḥ |
itīva rāmo dharmātmā saumitriṃ tamuvāca ha
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! You get down from the top of the tree. Act on my word." Thus spoke the virtuous Rama to that Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: from the top of the tree

verses.devanagari:
अवतीर्य तु साल अग्रात् तस्मात् स समितिम् जयः |
लक्ष्मणः प्रान्जलिर् भूत्वा तस्थौ रामस्य पार्श्वतः
verses.iast:
avatīrya tu sāla agrāt tasmāt sa samitim jayaḥ |
lakṣmaṇaḥ prānjalir bhūtvā tasthau rāmasya pārśvataḥ
verses.translation: Descending from the top of that Sala tree, Lakshmana the victorious in battle, with joined palms, stood by the side of Rama.

verses.devanagari:
भरतेन अथ संदिष्टा सम्मर्दो न भवेद् इति |
समन्तात् तस्य शैलस्य सेना वासम् अकल्पयत्
verses.iast:
bharatena atha saṃdiṣṭā sammardo na bhaved iti |
samantāt tasya śailasya senā vāsam akalpayat
verses.translation: Commanded by Bharata that no trampling of army should be made in the hermitage of Rama, the army was encamped round the mountain.

verses.devanagari:
अध्यर्धम् इष्क्वाकु चमूर् योजनम् पर्वतस्य सा |
पार्श्वे न्यविशद् आवृत्य गज वाजि रथ आकुला
verses.iast:
adhyardham iṣkvāku camūr yojanam parvatasya sā |
pārśve nyaviśad āvṛtya gaja vāji ratha ākulā
verses.translation: That royal army of Ikshvaku race, crowded with elephants horses and chariots was encamped around the edge of the mountain occupying an area of one Yojana and a half.

verses.devanagari:
सा चित्र कूटे भरतेन सेना |
धर्मम् पुरः कृत्य विधूय दर्पम् |
प्रसादन अर्थम् रघु नन्दनस्य |
विरोचते नीतिमता प्रणीता
verses.iast:
sā citra kūṭe bharatena senā |
dharmam puraḥ kṛtya vidhūya darpam |
prasādana artham raghu nandanasya |
virocate nītimatā praṇītā
verses.translation: Brought by the virtuous Bharata, who laid aside his arrogance, placing the righteousness in forefront in order to propitiate Rama, that army showed itself to be disciplined in the vicinity of Chitrakuta.
